{{Quote|Who's cooking these days?|Han Solo, his appetite longing for the late chef|<ref name="TNR" />}}
An '''individual''' worked as a [[Chef/Legends|chef]] at the [[food court]] of [[Skip 1]], an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] of<ref name="TNR" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]]<ref name="Underworld">{{InsiderCite|89|Underworld: A Galaxy of Scum and Villainy}}</ref> [[Smuggler's Run]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]]. She held a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] reputation during the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] first [[Time/Legends|time]] at the [[Restaurant/Legends|food court]]. However, she had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a [[Temperature/Legends|hot]]-[[Grease/Legends|grease]] duel with another chef<ref name="TNR" /> by [[17 ABY]], and in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> Solo recalled the chef's death while visiting the asteroid's [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] court, with his palate longing for her. In reply to his query as to who took charge of cooking for the venue, Solo's long-time smuggler associate [[Ana Blue]] spoke of a former [[Hapes Consortium]] [[Unidentified male chef|cuisine artist]].<ref name="TNR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The chef was mentioned in [[Kristine Kathryn Rusch]]'s [[1996]] novel ''[[The New Rebellion]]''.<ref name="TNR" />
